description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Leidos is hiring Java Software Engineers for its Intelligence Organization in San Diego. The role involves designing, developing, integrating, testing, and sustaining mission-focused software, including backend services and full-stack web applications.
Java Software Engineer building secure full-stack web applications, backend APIs, and persistence layers across hybrid environments

Responsibilities:
• The Java Software Engineers will build and maintain web applications, including web services, full-stack development, and persistence layers. You’ll work in an Agile Scrum environment alongside a cross-functional team of engineers, information assurance, quality assurance, and customer representatives. Using clean coding practices and S.O.L.I.D. principles, you’ll deliver code that is maintainable, secure, and reliable
• Developing and maintaining Java-based backend services, APIs, integrations, and persistence-layer components
• Developing and maintaining full-stack web applications, including user-interface components and web services
• Translating user stories, acceptance criteria, system engineering artifacts, and technical requirements into maintainable, secure, and testable software
• Applying secure software-development principles, clean-code practices, automated testing, and established configuration-management processes
• Supporting software integration, troubleshooting, defect resolution, and deployment across development, integration, test, and operational environments
• Participating in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and technical discussions
• Collaborating with teammates to maintain a high standard of engineering rigor, code quality, test coverage, documentation, and delivery discipline
• Using approved development, build, continuous integration, test automation, and code-quality tools to support reliable software delivery
• Support development, integration, and deployment of software across on-premises, cloud-hosted, and containerized hybrid environments, collaborating with infrastructure and cybersecurity teams as needed
• Apply established development practices with guidance, contribute to defined software components, participate in peer reviews and testing, and build proficiency in the program’s tools, architecture, and mission domain

Requirements:
• The Java Software Engineers will build and maintain web applications, including web services, full-stack development, and persistence layers
• Using clean coding practices and S.O.L.I.D. principles, you'll deliver code that is maintainable, secure, and reliable
• Bachelors
• Must have an Active Secret Security Clearance
